entities.summary: Astou Traoré is a Senegalese women's basketball player. She is also a regular on the Senegalese women's national basketball team. She signed for Spanish team Uni Girona CB. She played previously with Rivas Futura of the Spanish Liga Femenina de Baloncesto.
